model.name: FeatureManager.listFeatures
model.description: listFeatures(): the admin READ — scans ior:class:Feature units and returns [{uuid, name, icon, allowedUsers}] for the FeatureManager view. Read-only (no mutation, no owner-gate in the method itself — the HTTP GET /api/feature-manager wrapper is owner-gated via requireFeatureAccess). LOAD-BEARING marked decl for the GET read (the HTTP handler is a thin wrapper, NOT a node — serverManagerPage precedent). Expert marks [impl:uuid] on the listFeatures decl (#126). Architect ruling 4e713fb6b.
